hypothesis: Theorem 2 (paper section 2.2) says the Shannon rate-distortion pair (q_D, K_D) is a stochastic fibration for every distortion budget D >= 0 -- a one-parameter deformation of the sufficiency fibration Theorem 1 provides, with q_0 minimal-sufficient and q_{D_max} the constant map. For two finite sources (uniform on n=4 symbols; Bernoulli(p=0.3)) under Hamming distortion, the RD function R(D) has an exact closed form; the RD-optimal test channel achieves I(X; X_hat) = R(D) at every distortion budget in the achievable regime; R(0) equals the source entropy (Theorem 1 anchor); R(D_max) = 0 (encoder collapses to a constant); R is monotone nonincreasing in D; and R is convex on the grid.

gates.RDP_UNIFORM_N4_RATE_MATCHES_CLOSED_FORM: R(D) for uniform-on-4-symbols Hamming source matches log2(n) - h(D) - D*log2(n-1) exactly at every D in the pre-registered 10-point grid.
gates.RDP_UNIFORM_N4_TEST_CHANNEL_ACHIEVES_RAT: The symmetric error-D test channel achieves I(X; X_hat) = R(D) exactly for every D < 1 - 1/n = 0.75.
gates.RDP_UNIFORM_N4_R_AT_ZERO_EQUALS_SOURCE_E: R(0) = log2(n) = 2 bits, matching the Theorem-1 minimal-sufficient identity partition.
gates.RDP_UNIFORM_N4_R_AT_DMAX_IS_ZERO: R(1 - 1/n) = R(0.75) = 0, matching the constant encoder.
gates.RDP_UNIFORM_N4_R_MONOTONE_AND_CONVEX: R is nonincreasing in D and satisfies the convexity midpoint inequality on the grid.
gates.RDP_BERNOULLI_P03_RATE_MATCHES_CLOSED_FO: R(D) for Bernoulli(0.3) Hamming source matches H2(p) - h(D) exactly at every D in the pre-registered 9-point grid.
gates.RDP_BERNOULLI_P03_TEST_CHANNEL_ACHIEVES_: The RD-optimal test channel achieves I(X; X_hat) = R(D) exactly for every D < min(p, 1-p) = 0.3.
gates.RDP_BERNOULLI_P03_R_MONOTONE_AND_CONVEX: R is nonincreasing in D and convex on the grid.
